findings.issue: In dark theme getPickedColor reverts every sampled pixel, but renderElement.ts does not pass raster image elements through applyDarkModeFilter (only SVG images are inverted, and with a different filter). Picking a colour from a PNG/JPEG image in dark theme will therefore return a wrongly inverted colour. This is outside the accepted change_plan (it does not mention images), so it is advisory, not a regression in the targeted shape fix. Confidence: medium.
findings.fix: Optional follow-up: skip the revert when the pointer is over a non-SVG image element (e.g. via app.getElementAtPosition), or record this as a known limitation in the plan/issue.

passing_checks: Correctness vs change_plan: revertDarkModeFilter matches the closed-form inverse (2L - I hue-rotate, (v - 255p)/(1 - 2p) invert, single clamp+round, rgbToHex with alpha); no cache; forward path, cssInvert, cssHueRotate and DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE untouched.

EyeDropper: only onChange and onSelect go through getPickedColor; preview swatch keeps the raw sample; appState.theme added to effect deps; all three entry points (picker, i hotkey, bucket fill) share this choke point.
Type safety: no any; one `as unknown as ImageData` in a test stub, which is justified.
Error handling: pure arithmetic, nothing swallowed.
Authz / PII: not applicable (client-side colour util).
DRY: the expectHexWithin helper is duplicated across two test files by explicit plan decision (no shared test util across packages); acceptable.

Tests: dark-theme case covers both the onChange (move) and onSelect (release) paths plus preview-unchanged; light-theme case pins exact passthrough; colors.test covers unclamped round-trip and alpha 6/8-char handling; existing cases and snapshots untouched.
